source: 2016/TSB Vol 16 No 07 - Arctic Blast R134 Straight Tool Discontinued.pdf
title: Straight R-134 Arctic Blast Injector Tool
lead: The MOC Machine and Equipment Department is discontinuing the straight R-134 Arctic Blast Injector Tool (Part No. 76020). Only the 90-degree R-134 Arctic Blast Injector Tool (Part No. 76008) will remain available, given that it is more versatile and convenient for tight spaces.
